# PanePilot v0.18.0

PanePilot 0.18.0 makes frequently used project content easier to reopen while improving terminal recovery and LaTeX editing.

- Open Markdown from the clipboard or a local file in a searchable, resizable viewer
  that keeps the last 50 snapshots on this PanePilot client; resize the main workspace
  split and return to its saved balance after restarting.
- Run the last used project Action from its compact popup, archive and restore ordinary
  terminal tabs, and use **Force reload** to recreate a shell or agent backend in the
  same tab—including dormant SSH sessions—without duplicating the workspace record.
- Keep LaTeX source synchronized with always-on autosave and explicit conflict choices
  when a local or SSH file changes outside PanePilot while an editor draft is open.

## Update or download

In PanePilot v0.16.0 or newer, open **More toolbar actions → Check for updates…**,
then use **Restart to update** after saving your drafts. Installation is never
automatic. Earlier public releases require one manual installation from the DMG
or ZIP.

The downloads support Apple silicon Macs running macOS 12 or newer. They are ad-hoc
signed and not Apple-notarized; Sparkle signatures verify updates, not Apple
developer identity. Verify downloads with the attached `SHA256SUMS.txt`.

Persistent tmux sessions remain available for reconnection. Plain PTY terminals do
not survive app exit, and SSH port forwards must be reopened after restarting.
